scenario: A hidden screen keeps collecting updates. How would you make collection follow visibility?
rubric: Use repeatOnLifecycle with a suitable active lifecycle state.
Explain cancellation while stopped and restarting collection while active.
Distinguish collection lifetime from producer lifetime.
Explain the approach in a clear sequence with assumptions and an example.
misconceptions: A plain launch automatically stops collecting when the screen stops.
